BrochureContent.Content:
Sherry FitzGerald is delighted to present No. 1 St. Mochtas Lawn to the market, a superb 3 bedroom detached family home presented in excellent condition throughout. Extending to approximately 87 sq.m. / 936 sq.ft., this bright and spacious property offers a well balanced accommodation, ideal for first-time buyers, growing families, or those seeking a turnkey home in a highly desirable location.

The ground floor comprises a welcoming entrance hallway with understairs guest W.C., a generous living room perfect for relaxing or entertaining, and a bright open-plan kitchen/dining room to the rear overlooking the garden. Upstairs, there are two spacious double bedrooms, both with fitted wardrobes, including the main bedroom benefitting from en-suite, along with a good sized single bedroom and a family bathroom.

The property has an impressive rear garden, offering excellent privacy and significant scope to extend further, subject to the required planning permission. To the front, a paved driveway provides comfortable off-street parking for two cars.
Combining spacious accommodation and exciting future potential, No. 1 St. Mochtas Lawn offer a wonderful opportunity to acquire a detached family home in a sought-after residential setting.

Situated just off the Clonsilla Road, this property is just a short stroll from Clonsilla Village, with shops, Lidl store, restaurants, a bar and pharmacy. There are also a variety of local schools, including St Mochta's National School and St Francis Xavier. Blanchardstown Shopping Centre is just a 5-minute drive, with every conceivable amenity available. Coolmine Train Station is just a 15-minute walk approx, as well as having the both the no. 37 & 39 bus stops just around the corner, providing easy access to Dublin City Centre. The M50 and M3 are also a short drive away, making commuting to and from the city, as well as further afield, an ease.

Entrance Hall - 
With tiled flooring. There is an under stairs wc, along with a storage press.

Guest WC - 
Under-stair guest WC with tiled flooring. Comprises of a wc and wash hand basin.

Living Room - 
A well-proportioned living room with a large window, allowing ample sunlight to the room. Double doors lead to the open-plan kitchen/dining area. An open fireplace provides a lovely focal point to the room.

Kitchen - 
Located to the rear of the house, with tiled flooring. There is an excellent selection of floor and overhead presses, with an integrated gas hob, oven and fridge/freezer.

Dining Room - 
Open-plan to the kitchen, with tiled flooring, this is a great space, with scope to have an additional living area. A sliding door provides access to the fantastic, to rear garden.

Landing - 
A spacious landing, with carpet flooring continuing from the stairs, with a hotpress.

Bedroom 1 - 
An impressive double bedroom with timber flooring, located to the rear of the house. Fitted wardrobes provides fantastic storage space.

Ensuite - 
Partially tiled bathroom comprising of a wc, corner shower and wash hand basin.

Bedroom 2 - 
A second double bedroom with timber flooring and fitted wardrobes. Located to the front of the house.

Bedroom 3 - 
A generous single bedroom with timber flooring and a fitted wardrobe.

Bathroom - 
A good-sized family bathroom with lino flooring and partly tiled walls. Comprises of a wc, wash hand basin and a shower over bath.

• Detached house
  • Not overlooked
  • Large rear garden
  • Upgraded Smart bolier - GFCH
  • Attic is floored with foam insulation
  • 3 bathrooms
  • Driveway to fit 2 cars
  • 12 Minute walk approx. to Coolmine Train Station
